title: Why Becoming a Genius Won't Fix Your Life 🧠 #shorts

snippet.title: Why Becoming a Genius Won't Fix Your Life 🧠 #shorts
snippet.description:
What if becoming infinitely smarter actually made your life more dangerous? In Limitless (2011), Eddie Morra takes NZT-48 and experiences superhuman cognitive expansion. But his abilities expand far faster than his judgment. He outthinks Wall Street titans, yet borrows money from violent loan sharks and chains himself to chemical dependence.

Discover the profound cinematic distinction between cognitive speed and existential wisdom: Intelligence can help you get whatever you want, but only wisdom helps you decide whether you should want it.
